Alex Rivera is a 62-year-old never-smoker who lives in Columbus, Ohio. Diagnosis: stage IV lung adenocarcinoma, EGFR exon 19 deletion detected on tumor NGS. ECOG performance status 1. MRI brain without evidence of metastases. Labs today: creatinine 0.9 mg/dL, eGFR 85 mL/min, AST 28, ALT 22, total bilirubin 0.6 mg/dL, ANC 3200/uL, platelets 210000/uL, hemoglobin 12.4 g/dL. Measurable lung and mediastinal disease on CT.

Sam Okonkwo is a 54-year-old never-smoker who lives in Cincinnati, Ohio. Diagnosis: stage IV lung adenocarcinoma with an ALK rearrangement. The patient was treated with alectinib as first-line therapy and has radiographic progression. EGFR mutation not detected. KRAS mutation not detected. PD-L1 TPS 5%. ECOG performance status 0.
